blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, QUEZON, Philippines — The municipal government of San Juan, Batangas, has conducted basic Filipino Sign Language (FSL) training for its employees to promote more inclusive and accessible public services. Municipal personnel from various departments took part in the three-day training held on Nov. 10 to 12, where they learned basic sign language skills
